alerts.name: CephErrorState
alerts.note: Ceph is in Error state longer than 5m, please check status of pools and OSDs
alerts.note_en: Ceph is in Error state longer than 5m, please check status of pools and OSDs
alerts.action:
1) 立即用 ceph health detail 看具体是哪一项 ERR；
2) 常见为 PG inactive/incomplete、OSD 大量 down、或 full osd 导致集群只读；
3) 先恢复 down 的 OSD 或释放已满 OSD 的空间，这是绝大多数 ERR 的根因；
4) 恢复期间不要执行扩缩容或调整 crush map，避免加重数据迁移。

alerts.name: CephOsdReweighted
alerts.note: OSD {{ $labels.ceph_daemon}} on cluster {{ $labels.cluster}} was reweighted for too long. Please either create silent or fix that issue
alerts.note_en: OSD {{ $labels.ceph_daemon}} on cluster {{ $labels.cluster}} was reweighted for too long. Please either create silent or fix that issue
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph osd tree 确认是哪个 OSD 被降权、当前权重多少；
2) 确认是人工 reweight 还是 reweight-by-utilization 自动调整；
3) 若故障已恢复，用 ceph osd reweight <id> 1.0 恢复权重让数据回填；
4) 若是为了平衡容量而降权，评估是否该改用 balancer 模块统一处理。

alerts.name: CephOSDUtilization
alerts.note: Osd free space for  {{ $labels.osd }} is higher tan 90%. Please validate why its so big, reweight or add storage
alerts.note_en: Osd free space for  {{ $labels.osd }} is higher tan 90%. Please validate why its so big, reweight or add storage
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph osd df 看各 OSD 使用率分布，确认是个别 OSD 偏高还是整体接近满；
2) 个别偏高的用 ceph balancer status 确认均衡器是否开启，未开启则 ceph balancer on；
3) 整体接近满的必须扩容 OSD，或先删除无用的 pool/快照释放空间；
4) 应急可临时调高 mon_osd_full_ratio 争取时间，但这是危险操作，必须同时进行扩容。

alerts.name: CephPgActivating
alerts.note: Some groups are activating for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Those PGs are unavailable for too long!
alerts.note_en: Some groups are activating for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Those PGs are unavailable for too long!
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph -s 与 ceph health detail 看集群整体状态和具体告警项；
2) 用 ceph pg dump_stuck 与 ceph pg <pgid> query 定位卡住的 PG 及其原因；
3) 多数情况根因是 OSD down 或磁盘满——先恢复 OSD 或释放空间，PG 会自动回到 active+clean；
4) 恢复期间用 ceph -w 持续观察，避免同时做其他会加重负载的操作。

alerts.name: CephPgBackfillTooFull
alerts.note: Some groups are located on full OSD on cluster {{ $labels.cluster }}. Those PGs can be unavailable shortly. Please check OSDs, change weight or reconfigure CRUSH rules.
alerts.note_en: Some groups are located on full OSD on cluster {{ $labels.cluster }}. Those PGs can be unavailable shortly. Please check OSDs, change weight or reconfigure CRUSH rules.
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph osd df 找出空间不足的 OSD；
2) 释放空间或扩容 OSD 是根本解法；
3) 应急可调高 osd_backfill_full_ratio 让回填继续，但要确认磁盘确实还有余量；
4) 回填完成前避免再有 OSD 下线，否则冗余会进一步降低。

alerts.name: CephPgDown
alerts.note: Some groups are down (unavailable) for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please ensure that all the data are available
alerts.note_en: Some groups are down (unavailable) for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please ensure that all the data are available
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph pg <pgid> query 看 down 的原因，重点看 blocked_by 指向哪些 OSD；
2) 把这些 OSD 恢复上线是最直接的解法——通常是磁盘或主机故障；
3) OSD 确实无法恢复时，需要评估 osd lost 操作的数据丢失风险后再执行；
4) 全程记录操作，涉及数据丢失的决策要有人复核。

alerts.name: CephPgIncomplete
alerts.note: Some groups are incomplete (unavailable) for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please ensure that all the data are available
alerts.note_en: Some groups are incomplete (unavailable) for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please ensure that all the data are available
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph -s 与 ceph health detail 看集群整体状态和具体告警项；
2) 用 ceph pg dump_stuck 与 ceph pg <pgid> query 定位卡住的 PG 及其原因；
3) 多数情况根因是 OSD down 或磁盘满——先恢复 OSD 或释放空间，PG 会自动回到 active+clean；
4) 恢复期间用 ceph -w 持续观察，避免同时做其他会加重负载的操作。

alerts.name: CephPgInconsistent
alerts.note: Some groups are inconsistent for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Data is available but inconsistent across nodes
alerts.note_en: Some groups are inconsistent for too long on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Data is available but inconsistent across nodes
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph health detail 找出不一致的 PG，再用 rados list-inconsistent-obj <pgid> 看具体对象；
2) 用 ceph pg repair <pgid> 触发修复，Ceph 会用权威副本覆盖；
3) 修复前确认坏的是哪一份——若主副本本身损坏，需先确认权威副本可靠；
4) 反复出现不一致的 OSD 要查磁盘 SMART，多为坏道，应换盘。

alerts.name: CephPgUnavailable
alerts.note: Some groups are unavailable on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please check their detailed status and current configuration.
alerts.note_en: Some groups are unavailable on {{ $labels.cluster }}. Please check their detailed status and current configuration.
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph -s 与 ceph health detail 看集群整体状态和具体告警项；
2) 用 ceph pg dump_stuck 与 ceph pg <pgid> query 定位卡住的 PG 及其原因；
3) 多数情况根因是 OSD down 或磁盘满——先恢复 OSD 或释放空间，PG 会自动回到 active+clean；
4) 恢复期间用 ceph -w 持续观察，避免同时做其他会加重负载的操作。

alerts.name: CephTargetDown
alerts.note: CEPH target down for more than 2m, please check - it could be a either exporter crash or a whole cluster crash
alerts.note_en: CEPH target down for more than 2m, please check - it could be a either exporter crash or a whole cluster crash
alerts.action:
1) 确认 ceph exporter / mgr 所在节点是否存活，进程是否运行；
2) 用 ceph -s 在任一 mon 节点手工确认集群本身是否健康；
3) mgr 挂了会导致大量指标缺失，用 ceph mgr fail 触发切换到备用 mgr；
4) 恢复采集后确认历史数据缺口，注意盲区期间没有告警。

alerts.name: CephWarnState
alerts.note: Ceph is in Warn state longer than 30m, please check status of pools and OSDs
alerts.note_en: Ceph is in Warn state longer than 30m, please check status of pools and OSDs
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph health detail 看具体是哪些 WARN 项；
2) 常见为 OSD 单点 down、PG 未 clean、时钟偏移、pool 未设置 pg_autoscale；
3) 逐项按提示处理，Ceph 的 health detail 通常已给出明确指引；
4) 处理完确认 ceph -s 回到 HEALTH_OK。

alerts.name: MonitorAvailableStorage
alerts.note: Monitor storage for {{ $labels.monitor }} less than 30% - please check why its too high
alerts.note_en: Monitor storage for {{ $labels.monitor }} less than 30% - please check why its too high
alerts.action:
1) 用 df -h 确认 /var/lib/ceph/mon 所在分区的余量；
2) mon 目录膨胀最常见的原因是集群长期不 clean 导致 osdmap 无法裁剪——先解决集群 health 问题；
3) 用 ceph tell mon.<id> compact 触发 rocksdb 压缩释放空间；
4) 长期需给 mon 单独分配更大的磁盘。

alerts.name: MonitorClockSkewTooHigh
alerts.note: Monitor clock skew detected on  {{ $labels.monitor }} - please check ntp and hardware clock settings
alerts.note_en: Monitor clock skew detected on  {{ $labels.monitor }} - please check ntp and hardware clock settings
alerts.action:
1) 在各 mon 节点用 chronyc tracking 确认偏移量与上游源状态；
2) 确认所有 mon 节点用的是同一组 NTP 源；
3) chronyd 未运行的启动并设开机自启，偏移过大的用 chronyc makestep 强制对时；
4) 对完时后用 ceph -s 确认 clock skew 告警消失。

alerts.name: OsdApplyLatencyTooHigh
alerts.note: OSD latency for {{ $labels.osd }} is too high. Please check if it doesn't stuck in weird state
alerts.note_en: OSD latency for {{ $labels.osd }} is too high. Please check if it doesn't stuck in weird state
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph osd perf 看各 OSD 的 commit/apply 延迟，定位是个别还是普遍；
2) 个别 OSD 高延迟的，到该节点用 iostat -x 1 与 smartctl 检查磁盘健康与是否已打满；
3) 普遍高延迟的确认是否正在做大规模 recovery/backfill，可调低 osd_max_backfills 降低影响；
4) 磁盘故障的按换盘流程处理。

alerts.name: OsdDown
alerts.note: OSD is down longer than 30 min, please check what's the status
alerts.note_en: OSD is down longer than 30 min, please check what's the status
alerts.action:
1) 用 ceph osd tree 确认是哪个 OSD、在哪个节点；
2) 到该节点用 systemctl status ceph-osd@<id> 与其日志定位原因（磁盘故障、OOM、进程崩溃）；
3) 磁盘正常的直接拉起 OSD；磁盘故障的走换盘流程并 ceph osd out 让数据迁走；
4) 恢复期间用 ceph -s 观察 recovery 进度，避免同时下线更多 OSD。
